name: Doppler
desc: Moving sources tearing through a still medium, solved exactly: the retarded-time quadratic is evaluated at every pixel, so the wavefronts bunch tight and blueshift ahead of each source and stretch out redshifted astern with the colour read straight off the true Doppler factor, and once the ensemble walks past Mach 1 a silent zone opens with a sonic-boom cone tangent to every front — a fine mid-key thicket of interference fringes on an instrument slate, never a flash.

energy.doc: wavefront brightness, stroke weight and source glow (master knob)

scale.doc: wavefront spacing — a dense thicket of fine fringes at 0.4, a few huge slow fronts at 2.6 (the wave speed follows from it, so Mach is preserved)

speed.doc: overall time rate (source travel + wave propagation together, so Mach is preserved)

density.doc: number of sources in the medium (2 at 0 -> 5 at 1); the field is analytic, so they cost pixels, not shapes

mach.doc: ensemble source speed / wave speed. Each source carries its own 0.55-1.30 spread of it, so the frame mixes regimes: <1 subsonic Doppler asymmetry, ~1 the barrier, >1 a Mach cone and a silent zone

hue.doc: rotates the Doppler ramp; at the 120 default the colour is the true spectral shift (red astern, blue ahead)

x.doc: focus point sources steer toward on respawn

y.doc: focus point sources steer toward on respawn

act.doc: multi-minute programme: 'sweep' walks the Mach number up through the sound barrier section by section and settles just past it, 'steady' holds it, 'chase' drifts it slowly around

seed.doc: source seed — start positions, headings, path curvature, medium grain
